typography.instructions_to_main_agent: User explicitly requested Ubuntu. Pair Ubuntu for headings (friendly, tech/pharma feel) with IBM Plex Sans for body (highly legible, clinical, crisp). Implement increased font sizes universally as requested (base body is text-lg/text-xl).

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Inject these into tailwind.config.js using RGB values for opacity support (e.g., bg-vm-green/90). Limit primary green to CTAs/Headers. Use vm-accent strictly for 'YOUR PRICE' and B2B quantity offers to highlight savings.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat, solid surfaces. Avoid glassmorphism over clinical data. Cards must use bg-vm-surface with 1px border-vm-border and shadow-sm.
visual_enhancers.header: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-xl, bg-white/95, and a strict 1px bottom border-vm-border. Ensure z-50. NEVER fully transparent.
visual_enhancers.motion: Hover states must lift cards slightly (-translate-y-1) and increase shadow to shadow-md. Buttons must scale-95 on active. Use framer-motion for smooth staggered entrances.

layouts.global: Generous spacing. Section padding must be py-20 or py-24. Max-width containers mx-auto px-6 md:px-12.
layouts.home_page: Hero: Split layout - value prop text on left, strong brand image on right. Categories: Bento Grid Mode A. Brands: Infinite Marquee using react-fast-marquee (grayscale logos).
layouts.shop_page: B2B Layout. Left sidebar for accordion filters. Right grid: dense grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Product cards must heavily emphasize SKU, stock status, and B2B pricing structure.
layouts.product_detail: Left: Large gallery (react-zoom-pan-pinch). Right: Content block with title, SKU, variant table, bulk/quantity pricing tier selector, and large 'Add to Cart'. Bottom: Tabs (Shadcn) for Description/Composition/Downloads.
layouts.about_page: Corporate identity. Large typography. Use Bento grid for history/mission. High-contrast sections alternating between vm-bg and vm-ink (dark mode section) for impact.
layouts.auth_pages: Split screen. Beautiful corporate/veterinary image on one side, clean Shadcn form on the other. OTP input must use customized large inputs.

components.buttons: rounded-xl font-bold transition-all duration-200. Primary: bg-vm-green text-white hover:bg-vm-green/90. Secondary: bg-white border-2 border-vm-border text-vm-ink hover:border-vm-green.
components.inputs: Shadcn standard but override to h-14 (larger) and text-lg for B2B accessibility. Focus ring: ring-2 ring-vm-green.
components.tables: Use Shadcn Table for B2B bulk variants. Dense, left-aligned, clear hover states.

accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='shop-add-to-cart-btn', data-testid='login-otp-input').
accessibility.contrast: Maintain strictly minimum 4.5:1 text contrast. Secondary text must be text-vm-ink/70 minimum.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NOTE: Codebase uses .js files, NOT .tsx. Provide all React code in standard JS.
No generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Never use transparent backgrounds over content (e.g., sticky headers must have bg-color + blur).
MUST not apply universal transitions (`transition: all`); target specific properties.
Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Use pill-shaped or slightly rounded elements with interaction animations.
Ensure robust testability: ALWAYS include `data-testid` on interactive elements.
Never use placeholder image text; use the provided image URLs.
